answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 20670 Country: India Title: My question is about dawat-e-valima, it is that whether the menu should be only Non-veg or there is some flexiblity about the vegetarian dinner of valima? Question: Asslam-alaikum...... My question is about dawat-e-valima, it is that whether the menu should be only Non-veg or there is some flexiblity about the vegetarian dinner of valima? Answer ID: 20670 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 447/333/D=1431) Serving meat in wedding feast ( walimah ) is not necessary. walimah may be observed with whatever is available with ease. It may be vegetable as well. However it is mentioned in hadith: اولم ولو بشاة Hold a walimah , even if only with a sheep. Keeping it in view, if someone presents meat believing it mustahab, then it is ok. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
